en: Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a town square and adjoining main street. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk and stand on a wide, unpaved market area bordered by two‑ and three‑storey houses with gabled roofs and shop signs. The camera looks along a straight street lined with closely packed buildings. Printed captions at the bottom identify the view as the market with Dresdnerstrasse in Ortrand, and the publisher as Friedrich Silbermann of Ortrand.
